correctness.evidence: Adian–Atabekyan arXiv:1811.07167 cites cyclic finite subgroups and trivial center at odd n≥665. F.g. solvable torsion groups are finite by induction on derived length; finite subgroups cyclic. Squarefree 665 and gcd(665,φ(d))=1 for d|665 exclude finite normals.

originality.evidence: Adian already established finite and abelian subgroup cyclicity at n≥665; the solvable and normal corollaries use elementary generic induction and coprime automorphism order, adding no new method/open result.

scientific_value.evidence: Expository boundary for amenable-radical question, but no result on the full radical, C*-simplicity, or unique trace.

limitations: Assessment of novelty is relative to consulted primary Adian sources.
